_about: Questions in the demo replay (onevisit/demo.py `ask`): the replay answers a question with the saved official pages' own words, picked by keyword search (onevisit.search), never by Claude. These are the replay's own sentences around the quotes (no City fact lives here) and the example questions the app shows as chips. {link} is the service's official page, written as a Markdown link followed by its source id.
